info.name: saga-orchestrator Postman Collection
info.description:
Distributed transaction coordination using the Saga pattern. Manages 
long-running business transactions that span multiple microservices, 
with automatic compensation (rollback) when any step fails. Eliminates 
the need for distributed 2PC locks by orchestrating a series of local 
transactions with explicit compensation logic for each step.


OpenAPI version: 1.0.0

variable.description: Override with the base URL of the deployed Apigee proxy.
Unique identifier of the saga execution.
Include per-step outputs in the response.

request.description:
Define a new saga (distributed transaction)

Responses:
- 201: Saga defined successfully.
- 400: Invalid request payload or missing required fields.
- 409: A saga with this name already exists.
- 500: Internal server error.

body.raw: {"sagaName":"order-to-cash-flow","description":"Complete order fulfillment across payment, inventory, and shipping.","steps":[{"stepNumber":1,"stepName":"reserve-inventory","serviceName":"inventory-service","forwardAction":{"method":"POST","url":"https://inventory-service.internal/v24/reservations","headers":{"Content-Type":"application/json"},"bodyTemplate":{"orderId":"${saga.input.orderId}","sku":"${saga.input.sku}","quantity":"${saga.input.quantity}"},"timeoutSeconds":30,"retries":3},"compensationAction":{"method":"DELETE","url":"https://inventory-service.internal/v24/reservations/${steps.reserve-inventory.response.reservationId}","bodyTemplate":{},"timeoutSeconds":30},"outputMapping":{"reservationId":"$.id"}}],"failurePolicy":"COMPENSATE_ALL","maxTotalDurationSeconds":300,"owner":"commerce-team","notifyChannels":["SLACK"]}
